caption: The drawing consists of twelve rectangular panels, arranged in a grid of three columns and four rows on a light background. Each panel is filled with a distinct, colorful illustration dominated by floral motifs and decorative elements. The colors primarily used are red, blue, green, and yellow. The first panel (top left) features a red diamond shape surrounded by a floral wreath. The second panel shows two blue birds and a yellow bird amongst red flowers and green leaves, tied with a blue ribbon. The third panel has a symmetrical wreath of blue and green leaves, red flowers, and red ribbon with a blue bow at the base. The fourth panel (second row, first column) contains a bouquet, including blue, red, and yellow flowers tied together, with part of a bird visible. The next panel displays a tightly packed circular arrangement of pink and red flowers with green leaves and blue accents, tied with a red bow. The sixth panel has red roses with a yellow bird perched at the top among leaves and blue flowers. The seventh panel, starting the third row, shows a cornucopia filled with multicolored flowers and green foliage. The eighth panel features a red basket overflowing with various flowers and greenery. The ninth panel depicts a lyre surrounded by flowers and leaves in a circular wreath. The tenth panel, at the bottom left, contains another floral bouquet in a cornucopia with blue, red, and yellow flowers and a butterfly. The eleventh panel illustrates a blue bird holding an American flag flying above a shield and pink roses. The final twelfth panel (bottom right) shows a yellow pineapple surrounded by a wreath of green leaves and red accents, with a pink bow at the base. The name "Mary Ann Burton" is written in the lower right corner beneath the grid.
title: Applique Quilt (Friendship Quilt, or "Baltimo re Bride's Quilt")
